method: A glyph chain with no language behind it, fitted on the public training pages only. Each word is written glyph by glyph: the next glyph is drawn given the two before it in the word (counts of glyph trigrams inside words, with word start and word end as symbols), and the first glyph of a word is drawn given the last glyph of the word just written (counts of last-glyph, first-glyph pairs of adjacent words on a line). The first word of each ten-word row is drawn from the line-initial distribution instead. Nothing else is used: no word list, no word order, no meaning. Fixed seed, 13,000 words, generated once and not selected. The words are spelled afresh, so many are not manuscript words. On the practice split the text gives 0.217 bits against the manuscript's 0.229.
